thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API queue growth detected in us-west-2. GPU pool saturation >= 99% across pool-gpu-1. Autoscaler reports failed instance creations (5m window). Errors: "InstanceCreationFailed: quota exceeded". p95 generation latency climbing to 2.8s (baseline 0.5s), p99 > 15s. Request backlog: ~28k queued.

maya (oncall): on it. paging eng-runtime and infra. I’ll take first responder.

arjun (eng-runtime): seeing the same in metrics — continuous batching backlog spike. Autoscaler attempted 12 scale-ups, cloud returned 429 / QUOTA_EXCEEDED on 9 of them.

lena (sre): logs show provisioner errors:
```
2026-03-15T03:41:12Z provisioner -> CreateInstance failed: QuotaExceeded: Quota 'GPUs' exceeded for region us-west-2
2026-03-15T03:42:25Z autoscaler -> retry(3): CreateInstance failed: RateLimitExceeded
```

maya (oncall): customer-facing impact? any 5xx spikes?

noah (support): A handful of 504s spiking. Support dashboard shows ~120 customer requests failed in last 10m, mostly large-batch generation calls. I’ll page any customers with active SLAs after we have mitigation timeline.

arjun (eng-runtime): immediate mitigation options: 1) route new low-priority traffic to smaller/fast models (quantized 7B) 2) enable aggressive token/timeouts and fallback to cached responses for repeat prefixes 3) temporarily raise rate-limit for internal infra to drain control commands.

sam (infra): I can request quota increase but that’s slow. Shorter term we can try: force-provision from thin-pool in eu-west-1 and route traffic cross-region, or scale down batch sizes to free GPU capacity. Cross-region will add latency for some customers.

olivia (product): prioritize latencies for high-value customers. If cross-region mitigates, we'll inform enterprise accounts. For self-serve, we should auto-failover to smaller models and reduce timeouts to keep P95 reasonable.

lena (sre): I’m going to lock autoscaler to prevent further noisy retries (they're hammering the cloud and getting rate-limited). Setting retry backoff and max parallel creates = 2.

arjun (eng-runtime): done — updated autoscaler config to backoff mode. Command:
```bash
# toggle autoscaler noisy-retry protection
redwoodctl autoscaler update --pool gpu-pool-1 --max-parallel-create 2 --backoff 60s
```

maya (oncall): confirmed config change applied, create rates dropped. Queue still large but rate of failed creates halted.

sam (infra): started cross-region traffic reroute to eu-west-1 for low-priority routes. Will monitor for added tail-latency.

arjun (eng-runtime): implementing model downgrade routing policy now — route everything < 4k token to quantized-7b-v2. Patch pinned route:
```json
{ "route": "/v1/generate", "policy": "downgrade-on-saturation", "target_model": "quantized-7b-v2" }
```
Note: this is a quick patch, will revert once capacity recovers.

noah (support): sending proactive note to impacted customers: short message explaining degraded latencies and temporary routing to smaller models. Will include ETA once we know provisioning timeline.

olivia (product): please include note that model outputs may have slightly lower fidelity; assign CS to any flagged enterprise prompts.

lena (sre): monitoring p95/p99 now — p95 dropped from 2.8s -> 1.1s after downgrade routing, p99 still ~9s. Queue size drifting down to 18k. Good direction.

maya (oncall): what's the root cause? cloud GPU quota exhaustion or runaway customer?

sam (infra): initial root cause: sudden customer traffic surge (marketing campaign) + our thin-provision pool misconfiguration. The thin-pool had a lower reserve than expected and didn't fall back to dedicated capacity fast enough. Combined with cloud quota limits, autoscaler retries compounded the issue.

arjun (eng-runtime): adding that our continuous-batching heuristics kept aggregating requests which increased token-per-call workload — contributed to longer durations per GPU. Adjusting batching thresholds now to favor latency: set max-batch-tokens to 2048 and target-batch-ms to 20.

maya (oncall): arjun, can you deploy that patch?

arjun (eng-runtime): deploying patch to runtime now. Rolling update to 20% traffic first. `deploy/runtimeset-agg-optimize-20260315` in progress.

incident-bot: Deploy started by arjun (eng-runtime) — job id 67622.

arjun (eng-runtime): 20% roll looks stable. P95 trending down. I’ll continue ramp if metrics hold.

lena (sre): cloud quota request submitted (case 234567890) for emergency GPU quota increase; asking for expedited review. But cannot rely on it for immediate mitigation.

sam (infra): cross-region routing completed for low-priority routes. added sticky session exemptions for enterprise to keep them in-region.

noah (support): updated customers: message sent to 7 enterprise contacts and a banner to status.redwood.ai. Replied to two bump tickets.

olivia (product): track output quality regressions. Open a quick eval run on a representative prompt set against quantized-7b-v2 and baseline. Tag regressions.

arjun (eng-runtime): started automated evals. Early diffs look acceptable for most short prompts; longer docs show more hallucination risk. We'll mark longer-doc requests as high-cost and either queue or send 429.

maya (oncall): timeline: mitigation steps applied at 03:48Z (disable noisy autoscale / route downgrade / cross-region). Queue reduced 28k -> 6.2k by 04:15Z. p95 ~0.9s, p99 ~3.2s. We can start slow rollback when cloud quota confirmed.

lena (sre): creating post-incident issue: "autoscaler retries + thin-pool reserve mismatch" with actions: a) enforce reserve threshold, b) autoscaler backoff defaults, c) cross-region playbook, d) customer traffic shaping rules.

sam (infra): long-term: request quota baseline bump and add proactive quota monitoring with early alerts at 70%.

olivia (product): schedule customer follow-up for affected enterprise in next 24h, include RCA and mitigation steps.

noah (support): closing immediate support loop; will escalate any customers requesting credits to billing.

maya (oncall): handoff to oncall-next in 30m. Current status: degraded but stable, mitigations active. If anyone needs a runbook update, annotate the incident ticket.

arjun (eng-runtime): adding short-term code TODOs to the incident ticket: disable long-aggregate-batches during high queue, auto-fallback routing thresholds, and safer retry limits.

lena (sre): I’ll keep the monitoring alert open for another 3 hours, then we can resolve after postmortem check-in.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, service recovering. Open ticket: INC-20260315-07.

maya (oncall): thanks team. great coordination. Closing channel in 2 hours unless metrics regress. :thumbsup:
